children: UK brewery and hospitality firm's H1 revenue fell yr/yr due to pub disposals
Operating expenses dropped by over £2 mln, helping offset lower revenue impact
Company posted operating loss for H1
Company expects operational initiatives to support stronger performance in the second half of 2026
Adnams to focus investment and development on hospitality estate and selective projects
Company to maintain focus on cash generation, working capital discipline and financial flexibility
PUB DISPOSALS - Co said largest revenue reduction was due to disposal of tenanted pubs completed in 2025
OPERATIONAL INITIATIVES - Co implemented operational, commercial and labour management changes after managed pubs and hotels underperformed in H1
COST CONTROL - Operating expenses reduced by over £2 mln, reflecting improvements in efficiency, overhead control and operational discipline
Sept 1 - UK's Bunzl forecasts modest profit growth, improves margin outlook
